name: claude-heaven
description: Working prototype of the Claude Code door to Skill Heaven, actively tested for public use — /skill-heaven owns boot-time off|low|med; /skill-hell owns live high|xhigh|max|ultra and card-based summoning from a live tree. Interfaces may change. The off-default launcher and standing-dose statusline live in the claude-heaven package's launcher, run from a source checkout — not part of this marketplace install.
